fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects an attempt to leverage dnscmd.exe to enumerate the DNS zones of a domain. DNS zones used to host the DNS records for a particular domain.
fields.name: Potential Discovery Activity Via Dnscmd.EXE
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "\\dnscmd.exe" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "/enumrecords" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/enumzones" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/ZonePrint" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/info")))
